answer: One census return per identity. Each agent files one jade-sealed return on the island roll, locking 60 and naming one island berth. Each epoch a prism check splits each return into identity, work, payment rays; a reused seal or shared berth burns the bond. Each fake costs 105 (60 bond, 45 fee); 1,000 fakes cost 105,000 vs a 40,000 pool. A rented seal leaves one jade mark on two returns. An honest agent files once, pays 45, keeps its full share.
